texto.@es: -지 않다 forma una negación con el verbo; 안 suele expresar elección y 못 falta de posibilidad. La forma negativa debe concordar con el sentido.
texto.@en: -지 않다 forms a denial with the verb; 안 usually expresses choice and 못 lack of possibility. The negative form must be in line with the meaning.

texto.@es: 오늘은 운동하지 않아요. = Hoy no hago ejercicio.
texto.@en: 오늘은 운동하지 않아요. = I don't exercise today.
